rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.

(a) doctrine restatement — none; every bullet introduces content the chunk did not already hold, none re-announces a split/lens/law after it already did its work. Nothing added for the occasion', which echoes the sibling file test-and-learn.md's flagged §16(b) line ('Un-packaged first is by design', REVISE'd in ae101--lecture--test-and-learn.slides.json) in wording, but differs in function: test-and-learn's line came AFTER two bullets had already shown the full un-packaged/packaged contrast and added nothing; here raw:18 is the FIRST and only place 'un-packaged' is defined for this session, and the sentence does the defining work itself ('exactly as it stands, nothing added') rather than commenting on the curriculum's own design choice — does not fit the class. The rule's own worked example, 'You encounter the problems before the training names them', is confirmed ABSENT from the current body (cut 2026-08-25 per raw:41's maintainer accept-note; verified via `git diff 1abb84c6..HEAD -- curriculum/lectures/the-far-half.md`, which shows it removed as a '-' line with no replacement). (c) aphorism kicker — no closing bullet restates a header or a `**The point:**` line (this file has neither); raw:19's closing question introduces a new forward-looking prompt, not a restatement. No violation found.
